class.name: AudioBuffer
class.brief_description: A reference-counted buffer holding stereo audio frames.
class.description: A contiguous buffer of stereo [AudioFrame] data. Can be pre-allocated once and reused across audio processing operations to avoid memory allocations in performance-critical mixing loops.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the audio buffer, freeing its frames.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates and returns a new [AudioBuffer] initialized with the specified number of [param frames].

method.name: get_data_address
method.description: Returns the memory address of the raw audio frame data for GDExtension or native interoperability. Returns [code]0[/code] if the buffer is empty.

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the stereo audio frame at [param index] as a [Vector2] (X = left, Y = right).

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of audio frames in the buffer.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the buffer contains no frames.

method.name: resize
method.description: Resizes the buffer to contain [param frames] audio frames.

method.name: set_frame
method.description: Sets the stereo audio frame at [param index] from a [Vector2] (X = left, Y = right).

method.name: size
method.description: Returns the number of audio frames in the buffer. Alias for [method get_frame_count].
